questionEn: Which formulation more accurately distinguishes “sublimation” from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formula "sublimatsiya" ni o'xshash g'oyalardan aniqroq ajratib turadi?
choicesEn: Direct transition from solid to gaseous state
choicesUz: Qattiq holatdan gazsimon holatga bevosita o'tish
explanationEn: Sublimation: solid → gas without liquid phase.
